notes: Modified cash basis school district. Attempt 5 (re-trim added source p13 = trimmed p8, the right half of the first disbursements page): governmental receipts (p6) and disbursements (p8, p10) are taken line by line from the printed Total Governmental Funds column, which already nets the Reclass column (GF payments to the Educational Leasing Corp and the GF-to-Depreciation transfer); the computed Reclass contra lines of earlier attempts are dropped, and Debt related costs 1,672,186 is one printed line (Debt Service, principal and interest combined) instead of a split by fund column. The Total column prints Transfers (incoming) as '-', so transfers_in/out are null; roll-forward 7,013,317 + 13,978,141 - 13,571,413 = 7,420,045 (p10). 2900 Other support services 733,050 (Depreciation Fund) is categorised capital outlay because the Statement of Activities p2 counts it in Capital outlay 1,295,496. Business-type = School Lunch Fund (p11-12); USDA and state subsidy 119,480 kept as one printed line; business receipts total 431,675 from the Lunch budget schedule p22 (p12 prints operating 312,195 and nonoperating 119,480 separately). Activities Funds (p13) and Student Fees Fund (p14) are outside the district's net position and governmental totals; skipped (see decision_needed). Balance sheet: governmental lines from p4 (Total Governmental Funds), business-type and totals from p1; no liabilities. Detail: budgetary comparison schedules p15-22 (GF, Special Building, Depreciation, Bond, QCPUF, School Lunch); Activities and Student Fees budget schedules (p21, p23) skipped with those funds. GF schedule actuals differ by rounding of 1 from the statement (12,350,918 vs 12,350,919; 11,854,693 vs 11,854,694); the GF schedule's spending includes the 599,601 sent to the Depreciation Fund (kept as printed).
